questions.question_text: $4\%$ of a soil sample's mass is $18$ g. Find the total mass of the sample.

options.why: Multiplied $18$ by $4$ instead of dividing to find $1\%$ first.
Found $1\%$ correctly but forgot to multiply back up to $100\%$.
Found $4\%$ of $18$ g instead of treating $18$ g as the $4\%$.

questions.question_text: A battery is charged to $65\%$, which is $2600$ mAh. Find its full capacity.

options.why: Found $65\%$ of $2600$ instead of treating $2600$ as the $65\%$.
Found $1\%$ but did not multiply back up to $100\%$.
Multiplied $2600$ by $65$ instead of dividing to find $1\%$ first.

options.why: Treated $486$ as the $40\%$ that failed instead of the $60\%$ that sprouted.
Found $40\%$ of $486$ rather than scaling $486$ up from $60\%$ to $100\%$.
Assumed the number that sprouted was already the total planted.
